title: DOOM: The Dark Ages gets new Slaughter Mode 💀
subject: doom
description:
Would you secure your Skulls or risk it? 👇

Slaughter Mode, a randomized combat mode with escalating rounds, launches November 16, 2026 for DOOM: The Dark Ages on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. It is free for owners of the Revelations DLC, the Premium Edition or the Premium Upgrade. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma also said id Software is already working on its next game.

Sources: Gematsu (Nov 12, 2026), MIXED News (Nov 15, 2026), Xbox Wire (Nov 15, 2026), Shacknews (Nov 2026)
Game footage © id Software / Bethesda.

scenes.text: DOOM: The Dark Ages gets Slaughter Mode on November 16.
Each run brings randomized, escalating rounds of enemies, bosses and arenas.
At each Round Checkpoint, you Secure your Skulls or pick Risk It for a bigger multiplier. Die while risking, and you lose them.
Skulls buy Slayer skins, weapon skins and tracks from Andrew Hulshult's IDKFA soundtrack.
